buy.note: You approve this in the app. PasaBot only brings it to your cart, then you check the total and pay yourself.
buy.asked: Waiting for your approval. The money card is in your approvals.
buy.error: Could not ask for this one. Try again.

state.running: Approved. Adding it to the cart…
state.handedOver: It is in your cart. Check the total and pay yourself in the browser.
state.denied: You said no, so nothing was bought.
state.paused: Paused: the store needs you in the browser.
state.stopped: Stopped. Nothing was added to the cart; the chat says why.
state.ended: This Buy has ended; the chat says how.

settings.title: Shopping
settings.intro: Where your agents look for products. Prices are shown as the store page showed them, never converted.
settings.fallback: No store list for this country yet. Agents search the web, and show cards only for pages that describe a product.
settings.rules: Agents never pay, place orders, type card details, handle codes, solve captchas or make store accounts. Buying always asks you first.
settings.error: Could not load the shopping settings.

custom.name: Store name
custom.idHint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes, like corner-shop
custom.searchHint: Put {query} where the search words go
custom.hostsHint: Host names, comma separated, like shop.example or *.example
custom.currencyHint: Three letters, like PHP or USD
custom.error: Check the fields: the addresses must be on the allowed hosts and have no tracking codes.

onboarding.title: Where do you shop?
onboarding.body: Pick your country so your agents know which stores to look at. You can change it later in Settings → Shopping.

orders.title: Orders
orders.empty: No orders yet. A Buy you approve shows up here.

state.handed-over: In your cart, yours to pay

tools.shop_buy: Bring a product to the cart

server.noBrowser: The browser is not available, so nothing was added to a cart.
server.storeOff: This store is turned off in Settings → Shopping, so nothing was added to a cart.
server.badAddress: That product address is not allowed for this store.
server.stoppedBefore: Stopped before the browser was touched.
server.stoppedNothing: Stopped. Nothing was added to the cart.
server.priceChanged: The price changed since you approved: {{before}} then, {{after}} now. Nothing was added to the cart. A new card asks you again at the new price.
server.pageDiffers: The item or price on the store page is different from what you approved ({{price}}), so nothing was added to the cart. Capture it again and ask again.
server.openNoCartHandOver: {{name}} is open at {{store}}. Add {{quantity}} to your cart and pay yourself.
server.openNoCart: {{name}} is open at {{store}} in the browser. This store has no cart steps, so add {{quantity}} yourself and pay yourself.
server.stoppedAfterAdd: Stopped after adding to the cart; the checkout page was not opened.
server.checkoutSignUp: The checkout address is a sign-up page.
server.stoppedInCart: Stopped. The item is in the cart; nothing else was done.
server.inCartHandOver: {{quantity}} × {{name}} is in your cart at {{store}}. Check it and pay yourself.
server.inCart: {{quantity}} × {{name}} is in your cart at {{store}} and the checkout page is open in the browser. Check the total and pay yourself; PasaBot does not place the order.
server.stoppedCheck: Stopped. Check the browser before you go on.
server.captcha: The store shows a check for people (a captcha). Open the browser and finish it yourself.
server.signIn: The store wants you to sign in. Open the browser and sign in yourself (PasaBot never makes store accounts).
server.denied: You said no, so the browser was not touched.
server.askPayment: You pay yourself in the browser; PasaBot stops at the cart
